messages:
ana: uploaded a compact mock for the time-range + sampling control — trying to save vertical space for the latency dashboard. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE
kevin: Nice. First thought: the tiny preset buttons (1h / 6h / 24h) are great space-wise but low contrast against the bg. WCAG says 4.5:1 for normal text, these look ~3:1. Can we darken the label or add a 1px outline? :eyes:
maria: Also, for copy: replace isolated 'p95' label with '95th percentile (p95)'. Non-ML folks get confused and we get support tickets. Keep the short form in parentheses so charts don't overflow.
ying: Agree on copy. Accessibility nits: sampling slider needs an aria-label and visible focus state for keyboard users. Also consider step markers at 25% increments and a tooltip on drag that shows actual sample rate and estimated cost delta.
kevin: On the heatmap: if we stack the density legend vertically on the right, it eats less horizontal real estate on narrow screens. But that makes color gradients harder to compare to numeric p95 scale. Maybe allow user to toggle legend orientation?
a na: @ying can you drop a quick snippet for how the slider aria and tooltip should read? I'll hand to eng after design sign-off.
ying: sure — example:
```html
<input type=\"range\" min=\"0\" max=\"100\" step=\"5\" aria-label=\"Sampling rate: 50% - reduces cost but increases error variance\" aria-valuemin=\"0\" aria-valuemax=\"100\" aria-valuenow=\"50\">\n<!-- Tooltip text: 'Sampling: 50% — expected token cost ~0.6x' -->
```
kevin: Perfect. Minor UX debate: should the sampling control be inline with range preset buttons, or collapsed behind an icon that expands? Inline = more discoverable, collapsed = cleaner. My vote: inline on desktop, collapsed on mobile.
maria: For mobile collapse, add a clear affordance: 'Sampling • 50%' label that opens the slider. Avoid hiding it completely — it's an important control.
a na: design-bot uploaded a new variant: compact + accessible-focus (v2). Preview: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE_V2
design-bot: new variant uploaded by ana (compact + accessible-focus).
ying: quick keyboard shortcut proposal: when dashboard is focused, press 'T' to open time presets and 'S' to open sampling. Add a visible tooltip in the help menu.
kevin: UX tiny: move the p95 numeric up so it aligns baseline with the chart title; visually it reads cleaner. Also drop the unit from the chart title (ms) and show units in the axis tick only.
maria: copy tweak for the sampling tooltip: change 'reduces cost' to 'reduces inference cost' — more explicit for onboarding.
a na: noted. I'll update mocks: darker preset contrast, '95th percentile (p95)' label, slider aria + step markers, tooltip copy tweak, legend orientation toggle, keyboard shortcuts doc.
kevin: Can we also add a small 'why p95?' ?info button for first-time viewers that shows a one-liner and link to docs. Helps PMs too.
ying: +1, and ensure the tooltip is reachable by screen readers (aria-describedby).
maria: tagging product in the doc for copy review after mocks updated.
a na: thanks all — will push v3 by EOD. If no objections, I'll hand off to eng for implementation tickets. :thumbsup:
kevin: no objections, go ahead.
design-bot: thread archived after 1 reply (simulated).
